item.title: Scripps agrees to purchase WTVQ in Lexington from Morris Network, Inc. for $15.8 million
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (LEX 18) — The E.W. Scripps Company has reached an agreement to purchase WTVQ, the ABC affiliate in Lexington, Kentucky, from Morris Network, Inc. for $15.8 million.
